info.title: The code sheet of org.openmixer.param-contract/1: the codes a plugin's get() reports for a parameter's unit, and the standard unit each stands for

OMX_PARAM_CONTRACT_UNITS.description: The units of org.openmixer.param-contract/1, the code its get() reports for a parameter's plain value, by token: the LV2 unit a face writes for a descriptor unit (units:db is db), 0..24 the LV2 units one to one, 0x100 and up the vendor block of units LV2 has none for (256..259 and 260..263), append-only. A token is served when it has a code here; none is 0.

x-docs.none: no unit: a plain number, a switch, an index
x-docs.frame: audio frames (samples) at the running rate
x-docs.db: decibels, a relative level or a gain
x-docs.coef: a coefficient, a plain multiplier (1 is unity)
x-docs.degree: degrees of arc or of phase
x-docs.dbfs: decibels relative to full scale, 0 the largest sample, a level (vendor block)
x-docs.dbu: decibels relative to 0.775 V RMS, an analogue level (vendor block)
x-docs.ratio: a ratio, n to 1, as a compressor states it (vendor block)
x-docs.lufs: loudness units relative to full scale, ITU-R BS.1770 (vendor block)
x-docs.dbPerOct: decibels per octave, a filter slope (vendor block)
x-docs.dbPerS: decibels per second, a rate of level change (vendor block)
x-docs.dbtp: decibels relative to full scale, true peak, ITU-R BS.1770 (vendor block)
x-docs.lu: loudness units, a loudness difference, ITU-R BS.1770 (vendor block)

OMX_PARAM_CONTRACT_UNIT_IDS.description: The standard unit each code of OMX_PARAM_CONTRACT_UNITS stands for, by token: the const of a word of omx-contract's PARAM_UNITS as released (dB, Hz, deg, dBPerOct), never the lowercase key it is filed under. A descriptor and a reply carry the standard id, never the code; the code is this level's own and is read only by the encoder and decoder of the extension (the F2 mapping).
